outcome: Small or large for gestational age neonate
cohort: Patients with a singleton pregnancy who underwent universal HbA1c screening in early pregnancy at an urban tertiary care center between December 1, 2016, and December 31, 2018, excluding those with pregestational diabetes mellitus or gestational diabetes.
finding: After adjusting for confounders, elevated early HbA1c was independently associated with spontaneous preterm birth in nondiabetic patients.
mod_finding: Elevated early HbA1c was associated with a higher rate of Cesarean section in unadjusted analysis, but this association did not persist after adjusting for confounders.
